title: Bull&Bear Crypto Trading Simulator
description:

Whether you prefer high-risk leveraged trading, automated strategies, long-term investing, or passive income, every decision shapes your path to success.

description_short: Turn $1,000 into a crypto empire: 34 coins, up to 100x leverage, real liquidations. Unlock the options desk, spoof the order book with fake $10M walls, move markets as the whale — then run your own fund. Survive exchange hacks, stablecoin depegs and cascading crashes 📈
